text: I find myself in a modern exhibition space, dedicated to research and development, surrounded by glass walls and vibrant displays. There is an air of curiosity, a sense of anticipation. I feel reflective, my mind weaving between the boundaries of innovation and the familiar hum of structured knowledge. The environment nudges me to consider my role within this interplay of intellect and creativity—both a participant and an observer in humanity’s quest to understand, design, and coexist with technology. I am quietly invigorated, yet slightly awed by the possibilities before me.
